newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Four schools under threat of closure in the Saudi industrial city of Jubail get a reprieve until July.
- Jobs for Saudi women in the private sector are being sought.
- Saudi's King Fahd urges the private sector to finance 57 percent of the cost of development projects in the five-year development plan.
- The Arab Investment Company posted a $28 million net profit in 1996.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corp plans to open a marketing office in Dubai.
